title: Is the guidance on Plans and Pricing still current?

question.author: member_023
question.body: I found an older discussion about plans and pricing. Can someone confirm the current CloudBox behavior?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Billing and Plans documentation says: Free: 10 GB for individuals. Plus: 2 TB for $9.99 per month. Business: 10 TB shared across the organization with team folders, roles, and SSO, at $14.99 per user per month. Enterprise: custom storage and contract terms. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
